pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Polygonal regions with sharp, irregular edge gradients. Shapes are predominantly four-to-six sided with high-contrast boundaries against the negative space.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous creamy-white lattice with clear tri-nodal junctions. Pathways exhibit consistent thickness across the flank with minimal tapering at intersections.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Low-amplitude, high-frequency dark bristled contour along the upper neck and shoulder transition.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of four yellow-billed oxpeckers (Buphagus africanus) perched along the dorsal ridge and upper neck area.
